newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-AGA '96 profit seen down 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-AGA '96 profit seen down 14 pct.

text.p: Swedish medical and industrial gas maker AGA AB is expected to show a 14 percent fall in 1996 profit after financial items, excluding capital gains, to 1.81 billion crowns, according to a Reuter poll of 12 analysts.
Forecasts varied from 1.76 billion crowns to 1.95 billion.
Including capital gains of 1.79 billion crowns, the profit is expected to be 3.60 billion crowns.
The company itself has forecast its 1996 profit to be at least 15 percent lower in 1996, which would mean 1.79 billion crowns at the highest.
Earnings per share is seen at 5.30 crowns, the survey showed.
AGA is due to release 1996 earnings on March 3.
Analysts interviewed came from Aros, Carnegie, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Fiba, Fischer, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Matteus, Paribas, Swedbank and Ohman.
(Millions of Skr) AVG Interval Median analysts
